subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: Should this release immediately require versioned Gitcrawl evidence and quarantine legacy imported jobs, or should strict enforcement be staged?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes persisted-job compatibility and makes remote-provider availability part of repair intake, so rollout timing and operational ownership cannot be inferred from code correctness alone.

options.title: Stage Strict Enforcement
options.body: Land evidence acquisition and verification while preserving legacy acceptance until migration, rollback, and provider operations are proven and explicitly enabled.

options.title: Enable Strict Cutover Now
options.body: Require evidence-bound jobs immediately and accept that legacy jobs or provider incidents can halt repair intake.

options.title: Pause The Subsystem
options.body: Hold the PR until migration execution and provider-incident ownership are ready.

recommendation.title: Stage Strict Enforcement
recommendation.body: Land evidence acquisition and verification while preserving legacy acceptance until migration, rollback, and provider operations are proven and explicitly enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current Gitcrawl intake behavior and has the strongest implementation history for the proposed cutover.
